options.name: ackaggregation
options.description: Enable or disable ACK Aggregation.

options.name: ackonpush
options.description: Send immediate positive acknowledgement (ACK) on receipt of TCP packets with PUSH flag.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: applyadaptivetcp
options.description: Apply Adaptive TCP optimizations

options.name: buffersize
options.description: TCP buffering size, in bytes.

options.name: burstratecontrol
options.description: TCP Burst Rate Control C(DISABLED)/C(FIXED)/C(DYNAMIC). C(FIXED) requires a TCP rate to be set.

options.name: clientiptcpoption
options.description: Client IP in TCP options

options.name: clientiptcpoptionnumber
options.description: ClientIP TCP Option number

options.name: delayedack
options.description: Timeout for TCP delayed ACK, in milliseconds.

options.name: dropestconnontimeout
options.description: Silently drop tcp established connections on idle timeout

options.name: drophalfclosedconnontimeout
options.description: Silently drop tcp half closed connections on idle timeout

options.name: dsack
options.description: Enable or disable DSACK.

options.name: dupackthresh
options.description: TCP dupack threshold.

options.name: dynamicreceivebuffering
options.description: Enable or disable dynamic receive buffering. When enabled, allows the receive buffer to be adjusted dynamically based on memory and network conditions. Note: The buffer size argument must be set for dynamic adjustments to take place.

options.name: ecn
options.description: Enable or disable TCP Explicit Congestion Notification.

options.name: establishclientconn
options.description: Establishing Client Client connection on First data/ Final-ACK / Automatic

options.name: fack
options.description: Enable or disable FACK (Forward ACK).

options.name: flavor
options.description: Set TCP congestion control algorithm.

options.name: frto
options.description: Enable or disable FRTO (Forward RTO-Recovery).

options.name: hystart
options.description: Enable or disable CUBIC Hystart

options.name: initialcwnd
options.description: Initial maximum upper limit on the number of TCP packets that can be outstanding on the TCP link to the server.

options.name: ka
options.description: Send periodic TCP keep-alive (KA) probes to check if peer is still up.

options.name: kaconnidletime
options.description: Duration, in seconds, for the connection to be idle, before sending a keep-alive (KA) probe.

options.name: kamaxprobes
options.description: Number of keep-alive (KA) probes to be sent when not acknowledged, before assuming the peer to be down.

options.name: kaprobeinterval
options.description: Time interval, in seconds, before the next keep-alive (KA) probe, if the peer does not respond.

options.name: kaprobeupdatelastactivity
options.description: Update last activity for the connection after receiving keep-alive (KA) probes.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxburst
options.description: Maximum number of TCP segments allowed in a burst.

options.name: maxcwnd
options.description: TCP Maximum Congestion Window.

options.name: maxpktpermss
options.description: Maximum number of TCP packets allowed per maximum segment size (MSS).

options.name: minrto
options.description: Minimum retransmission timeout, in milliseconds, specified in 10-millisecond increments (value must yield a whole number if divided by  10).

options.name: mpcapablecbit
options.description: Set C bit in MP-CAPABLE Syn-Ack sent by Citrix ADC

options.name: mptcp
options.description: Enable or disable Multipath TCP.

options.name: mptcpdropdataonpreestsf
options.description: Enable or disable silently dropping the data on Pre-Established subflow. When enabled, DSS data packets are dropped silently instead of dropping the connection when data is received on pre established subflow.

options.name: mptcpfastopen
options.description: Enable or disable Multipath TCP fastopen. When enabled, DSS data packets are accepted before receiving the third ack of SYN handshake.

options.name: mptcpsessiontimeout
options.description: MPTCP session timeout in seconds. If this value is not set, idle MPTCP sessions are flushed after vserver's client idle timeout.

options.name: mss
options.description: Maximum number of octets to allow in a TCP data segment.

options.name: nagle
options.description: Enable or disable the Nagle algorithm on TCP connections.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for a TCP profile. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore \(_\) character. Other characters allowed, after the first character, are the hyphen \(-\), period \(.\), hash \(\#\), space \( \), at \(@\), colon \(:\), and equal \(=\) characters. The name of a TCP profile cannot be changed after it is created.  CLI Users: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks \(for example, "my tcp profile" or 'my tcp profile'\).

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: oooqsize
options.description: Maximum size of out-of-order packets queue. A value of 0 means no limit.

options.name: pktperretx
options.description: Maximum limit on the number of packets that should be retransmitted on receiving a partial ACK.

options.name: rateqmax
options.description: Maximum connection queue size in bytes, when BurstRateControl is used

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rfc5961compliance
options.description: Enable or disable RFC 5961 compliance to protect against tcp spoofing(RST/SYN/Data). When enabled, will be compliant with RFC 5961.

options.name: rstmaxack
options.description: Enable or disable acceptance of RST that is out of window yet echoes highest ACK sequence number. Useful only in proxy mode.

options.name: rstwindowattenuate
options.description: Enable or disable RST window attenuation to protect against spoofing. When enabled, will reply with corrective ACK when a sequence number is invalid.

options.name: sack
options.description: Enable or disable Selective ACKnowledgement (SACK).

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sendbuffsize
options.description: TCP Send Buffer Size

options.name: sendclientportintcpoption
options.description: Send Client Port number along with Client IP in TCP-Options. ClientIpTcpOption must be C(ENABLED)

options.name: slowstartincr
options.description: Multiplier that determines the rate at which slow start increases the size of the TCP transmission window after each acknowledgement of successful transmission.

options.name: slowstartthreshold
options.description: TCP Slow Start Threhsold Value.

options.name: spoofsyndrop
options.description: Enable or disable drop of invalid SYN packets to protect against spoofing. When disabled, established connections will be reset when a SYN packet is received.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: syncookie
options.description: Enable or disable the SYNCOOKIE mechanism for TCP handshake with clients. Disabling SYNCOOKIE prevents SYN attack protection on the Citrix ADC.

options.name: taillossprobe
options.description: TCP tail loss probe optimizations

options.name: tcpfastopen
options.description: Enable or disable TCP Fastopen. When enabled, NS can receive or send Data in SYN or SYN-ACK packets.

options.name: tcpfastopencookiesize
options.description: TCP FastOpen Cookie size. This accepts only even numbers. Odd number is trimmed down to nearest even number.

options.name: tcpmode
options.description: TCP Optimization modes C(TRANSPARENT) / C(ENDPOINT).

options.name: tcprate
options.description: TCP connection payload send rate in Kb/s

options.name: tcpsegoffload
options.description: Offload TCP segmentation to the NIC. If set to C(AUTOMATIC), TCP segmentation will be offloaded to the NIC, if the NIC supports it.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: Enable or Disable TCP Timestamp option (RFC 1323)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: ws
options.description: Enable or disable window scaling.

options.name: wsval
options.description: Factor used to calculate the new window size. This argument is needed only when window scaling is enabled.
